goldens.input: How often does Product Two check my website?
goldens.reference_answer: Every 60 seconds by default; the Business plan allows an interval as fast as 10 seconds.
Open Settings → Integrations → Slack and choose a channel.

goldens.input: Can I export my notes to PDF?
goldens.reference_answer: The Product Two documentation does not cover exporting notes, so it cannot be confirmed.
